title: Moonlit Curse
description: She was born without a wolf, but the alpha’s mark awakens something ancient within her soul.

seasons.title: The Awakening
seasons.description: The discovery of the ancient mark.

parts.text: The moon hung low and heavy in the sky, like a silver eye watching her every move.
She felt the burn on her shoulder before she saw it—a glowing crescent that shouldn't exist.
In the distance, a howl ripped through the silence. He was coming for her.
